Their numbers in the state legislature – paltry enough to share a single pizza, went the joke – have surged and ended the Republican super-majority. Democrats were on track to win four seats in the state senate and at least four in the house of representatives in the wake of Tuesday's election, eroding GOP control over one of the south's most conservative states. Democrats hailed it as a "correction" to GOP overreach. "It's a beginning we can build upon," said one blogger . pages.description: Ongoing improvements to the Transcaucasian Trail mean that the best way to experience the country’s natural beauty and rich cultural history is on foot.
pages.text: Armenia's Long-Distance Trail Runs More Than 500 Miles Past Ancient Monasteries | National Geographic TRAVEL BEST OF THE WORLD Why Armenia Is Becoming an Adventure Traveler’s Dream Destination Ongoing improvements to the Transcaucasian Trail mean that the best way to experience the country’s natural beauty and rich cultural history is on foot. Since 2017, the Transcaucasian Trail has connected Lake Parz, in Dilijan National Park, with the spa town of Dilijan to the west. Anush Babajanyan By Alicia Erickson Published October 20, 2026 Volcanic peaks. Silk Road–era guesthouses. Homemade cheese and apricot brandy after a day of hiking. All of this awaits visitors to the Armenian section of the Transcaucasian Trail (TCT), which stretches more than 500 miles from Meghri on the country’s southern border to Lake Arpi National Park in the north, winding through oak forests, deep river gorges, and remote mountain villages. Built largely by volunteers beginning in 2016, the TCT reconnects historic footpaths and shepherds' routes across the Caucasus. When it is completed sometime in the next decade, the trail will span 1,864 miles across Armenia, Georgia, and Azerbaijan. New downloadable maps, improved trails and signage, and expanded trekking services rolling out through 2027 will make it easier than ever to explore Armenia on foot. Despite these improvements, many sections of the trail see only a handful of hikers, allowing travelers to wander through dramatic landscapes and remote communities without the crowds. Search Twitter YouTube Facebook Instagram Flickr LinkedIn Arrastra Mountain Wilderness | Arizona View Map In Full Screen The 129,800-acre Arrastra Mountain Wilderness is located in Mohave, Yavapai, and La Paz counties, 100 miles northwest of Phoenix and 70 miles southeast of Kingman, Arizona. This sprawling wildland encompasses imposing landscapes and unique natural features. The Poachie Range, which trends northwest-southeast through the north-central portion of the wilderness, rises to almost 5,000 feet. The gradual southern slopes of the range are interrupted by several isolated volcanic plugs and numerous drainages, several of which have been deeply incised into a bright orange mudstone. The western and southern portions of the wilderness encompass more than 20 miles of the ephemeral Big Sandy and Santa Maria rivers. West of the Big Sandy River, the Artillery Mountains are dominated by the striking red Artillery Peak, a 1,200-foot-tall volcanic plug. The east side of the wilderness contains the uniquely pristine Peoples Canyon. pages.title: Artemis IV - NASA
pages.description: NASA is targeting the first Artemis lunar landing in early 2028. After launching the crew aboard the Orion spacecraft, they will transfer to a commercial lunar lander for transport to the surface of the Moon. Lander readiness will determine which provider will safely carry them to the surface and back to Orion in lunar orbit before the crew returns home aboard Orion—splashing down safely in the Pacific Ocean.

These fossils were preserved within expanding and contracting wetlands between 100,000-12,500 years ago. Many of the Pleistocene animals of Tule Springs are still alive today, including the coyote ( Canis latrans ), jackrabbit ( Lepus sp.), and aquatic snails. Some animals went extinct, disappearing from North America entirely. Columbian mammoths belonged to the same family as living elephants.
